erratum: r7.81 stopped before producing a score because some valid event detections were smaller than a 16x16 patch and the cached obstacle mask was empty. r7.81a preserves every row and reuses the already frozen r7.67a nearest-patch fallback from raw hash-bound detections. Labels, splits, alpha, threshold, weighting, and gates are unchanged.

data.rows: exact r7.64 eval event frames only
data.labels: frozen provisional VLM event role from r7.54 event contract; route intrusion=1, safe-lateral/context negative=0
data.parent_source_isolation: leave one complete source ID out

feature_vector.input: frozen r7.64 43x16x16 causal tensor and frozen expanded marker mask
feature_vector.empty_mask_fallback: per-detection nearest 16x16 patch from r7.67a hash-bound raw detections

probe.target: binary event role copied to every frame only inside its parent-isolated event
probe.standardization: training-fold weighted mean and standard deviation only
probe.weighting: equal class mass, equal source mass within class, equal frame mass within source; total weight equals training row count
